question: Who has made history by becoming the first woman vice president of the United States of America?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kamala Harris**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Kamala Harris has made history by becoming the first woman vice president of the United States__.
 
• Harris is the former Attorney general of California and now the first Black woman and African American elected as the vice president.
 
• As her mother is from India, she has also become the first person of Indian descent to hold the national office in the United States.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**
